values.note: RV sites $35 a night for York County residents, $65 for non-residents (matching the $65 Campspot read of 2026-10-13); York County seniors 60+, disabled, active military and county employees $31. Tent sites $21 / $40 / $18. Every reservation adds a $3.00 reservation fee plus tax.

fees.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/639/Camping-Information ('RV CAMPING RATES: (All reservations are subject to a $3.00 reservation fee and applicable taxes). York County Resident $35 / night ... Non-York County Resident $65 / night'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations up to 13 months ahead on Campspot (linked from the county's park page). 'Same-day reservations are not permitted. Camping reservations must be made 24-hours in advance.' 'Ebenezer Park is NOT a long-term campground. The maximum length of stay is 14 nights on a campsite.' Check-in 2-9 pm, out by noon; the registering camper must be 21+ and present for the stay; RVs and vehicles must fit on the site's concrete pad (others park in the day-use lot).

booking.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/639/Camping-Information ('camping reservations can be made 13 months in advance'; 'Same-day reservations are not permitted'; 'The maximum length of stay is 14 nights on a campsite') + https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/212/Ebenezer-Park (Make a Reservation link to Campspot), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/639/Camping-Information ('Each RV campsite is equipped with water, sewer, electric (50/30/20 amp)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 79 full-hookup RV sites on concrete pads and 5 tent sites with water and electric.

sites.source: https://www.yorkcountysc.gov/639/Camping-Information ('Ebenezer Park has 79 full hook-up RV campsites ... There are 5 tent sites each equipped with water, electric'), read 2026-10-21

note: York County park on Lake Wylie north of Rock Hill. --Claude
summary: York County's camping page: fees restructured to the resident base $35 with a +$30/night non-resident surcharge ($65, matching the 10-13 Campspot read) and the $3 reservation fee; Campspot 13 months ahead, no same-day booking (24 h cutoff), 14-night max, year-round, 50/30/20 A + water + sewer, 79 RV + 5 tent sites (all now manual). Note trimmed of the site-count restatement.
